Multiplication on the right by Hcd1 kills the cloud-complement term by (I −C)Hcd1 = 0; the pilot longitudinal term is killed by d(L) 1 d(L) 0 = 0. Hence TlHcd1 = Hld(L) 1 Al. The filled pilot and wire equal these regular-set formulas away from the puncture. Their continuity extends the equations through zero with the explicitly retained harmonic values. The installed tolls L−1, L−2, L−3 and Fourier Gram ratio L−4 restore precisely the finite primal, dual and transport identities; the Fourier transfer of Subsection 11.9 restores these factors and proves the asserted real matrix identities at every period. The lift carries these same ordered exterior operations and alias data; it does not reinterpret analytic transpose as complex conjugation away from the real slice.
